Title: Condition proof at one program point
Summary: The proofs facet checks a condition against the bounded symbolic state at a source point.
Command: dotnet run --project .\Tools\SharpProof.SymbolicCli\SharpProof.SymbolicCli.csproj -- analyze --file docs/readme-examples/invariants-positive/input.cs --target line:7:13 --facets proofs --condition "value > 0" --format text

Title: Runtime hazard proof for divide-by-zero
Summary: The symbolic CLI can report a concrete hazard at a specific operation without executing the method.
Command: dotnet run --project .\Tools\SharpProof.SymbolicCli\SharpProof.SymbolicCli.csproj -- analyze --file docs/readme-examples/runtime-hazard-divide-by-zero/input.cs --target line:7 --facets hazards --format text

Title: Unknown external effect boundary
Summary: Framework calls remain unknown unless source, IL, or an exact effect contract establishes their effects; no member-name catalog is consulted.
Command: dotnet run --project .\Tools\SharpProof.SymbolicCli\SharpProof.SymbolicCli.csproj -- analyze --file docs/readme-examples/capabilities-console/input.cs --target line:7 --facets effects --format text

Title: Conservative complexity classification
Summary: Complexity queries report the best proven Big-O plus the structural drivers that justify it.
Command: dotnet run --project .\Tools\SharpProof.SymbolicCli\SharpProof.SymbolicCli.csproj -- analyze --file docs/readme-examples/complexity-linear/input.cs --target line:10 --facets complexity --format text

Title: Conservative unknown for dynamic dispatch
Summary: Dynamic dispatch produces explicit unknown method-effect evidence instead of an optimistic verdict.
Command: dotnet run --project .\Tools\SharpProof.SymbolicCli\SharpProof.SymbolicCli.csproj -- analyze --file docs/readme-examples/symbolic-unknown-dynamic/input.cs --target line:5 --facets effects --format text
